== Description ==

[[Robbie Hendon]] (left, grey SWCCG cap, grey tee, goatee), [[Brandon Baity]] (center, olive zip hoodie over beige collar, beard), and [[Scott Lingrell]] (right, white hair, glasses, navy polo, khaki shorts) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
